summary_en: Japan Exchange Group will cancel 9,486,700 common shares on November 10, 2026, representing 0.92% of issued shares before cancellation. Post-cancellation issued shares will total 1,022,298,636.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Japan Exchange Group announced on October 27, 2026, that it will cancel 9,486,700 common shares of treasury stock. The cancellation will take effect on November 10, 2026. These shares represent 0.92% of the issued share capital prior to cancellation. Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares will be 1,022,298,636.
